product_one_liner.value: Bitly provides link and QR Code management that helps brands and businesses create, manage, and measure digital interactions across online and offline channels.
product_one_liner.notes: Bitly describes its product as a link and QR Code management platform for brands and businesses, used to create, manage, and measure digital interactions.

pricing_page.notes: Bitly has a public pricing page describing pricing and plans, so this is true even if some plan details require contacting the company.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Bitly's customer-story page includes a case study titled as a story about Hacking HR using Bitly and another about ASUG using Bitly Assist. | named_customers.0: Bitly's customer stories include the Hacking HR case study. | named_customers.1: Bitly's customer stories include the ASUG case study.

employee_band.notes: Bitly's LinkedIn company profile lists its size as 201–500 employees, matching the requested band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The Bitly.com company record lists New York City, and Bitly's LinkedIn profile lists its headquarters as New York, NY. | hq_country: The Bitly.com company record identifies the location country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: Bitly's press page states that it was founded in 2008, directly supporting the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The Bitly Engineering Blog has at least two technical posts: one describes NSQ, a message-processing system that formed a core part of Bitly, and another discusses infrastructure, architecture, and scaling. Both identify their author as snakes.

public_docs.notes: Bitly has a public developer portal for its API and a linked API reference covering its endpoints, meeting the developer-portal documentation criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current Bitly careers page lists Director, Website Strategy as its opening; it shows no AI, ML, or data-science-titled role.

model_provider.notes: Bitly's Assist help material describes a built-in AI assistant and its data handling but does not name a model provider. The visible security-center subprocessor entry names AWS for backup and redundancy, not as Bitly Assist's AI provider; the underlying access-controlled materials do not disclose an AI provider in the available public content. The provider is therefore unknown.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Bitly's Trust Center says it is SOC 2 compliant, and its trust page says it is GDPR compliant. Both are among the certifications requested. | compliance_certs.0: Bitly's Trust Center explicitly says it is SOC 2 compliant. | compliance_certs.1: Bitly's trust page explicitly says it is GDPR compliant.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company-specific funding record classifies Bitly's latest round as Series D; its profile also identifies that Series D as the latest round. | funding_date: The company-specific funding record dates the latest round to 2017-07-12, and the investment announcement is dated July 2017; the requested YYYY-MM value is 2017-07. | funding_amount_usd: The Bitly.com funding record gives the latest round amount as USD 63,000,000; Spectrum Equity's July 2017 announcement independently reports the $63 million investment.

raised_18mo.notes: Bitly's latest recorded round was the July 2017 Series D, long before the eighteen-month window preceding November 9, 2026; the dated investment announcement corroborates the timing.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A dedicated Associate Account Executive posting identifies a US Remote role and presents an Apply action. Although the separate jobs index has conflicting availability information, the posting itself exposes an application flow, so this is treated as hiring with some uncertainty.

launched_6mo.notes: Bitly's changelog identifies Dynamic Routing as a July 2026 feature, within the six months before November 9, 2026, and describes routing visitors to different destinations based on their context.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Bitly's dated announcement says it appointed Matt Young as Chief Technology Officer on March 19, 2026, within the twelve-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The Bitly customer case study lists Salesforce and Marketo as integrations, and Qualified's case study says Bitly chose its conversational marketing platform. These are visible CRM and sales/marketing systems associated with Bitly. | crm_stack_signal.0: The Bitly case study lists Salesforce as an integration. | crm_stack_signal.1: The Bitly case study lists Marketo as an integration. | crm_stack_signal.2: The Qualified customer case study says Bitly chose Qualified's conversational marketing platform.
